answer: Require a timber bond before an identity can transact: its join request travels a propagation thread through five established agents, each locking 100 tokens for 30 epochs. Endorsers sharing a funding root are rejected, so a cluster grown in one orchard counts as one and cannot self-vouch. If the identity is proven fake, all five stakes are slashed 100% and endorsers lose grading rights for 10 epochs. Each fake costs 500 tokens locked plus a 3-hour sequential delay puzzle that cannot be parallelized; 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 tokens and 3,000 CPU hours, no bulk discount.
